components.text: Desh is a rare metal found on the [color=yellow]Moon[color], used for advanced space technology.

You mine [color=cyan]Moon Desh Ore[color] to obtain Raw Desh, then smelt it into a Desh Ingot. [br] Unlike [ref=stellaris:items/titanium]Titanium[ref], desh is only found off Earth, so you will need to travel before you can gather it. [br] [br] It is used to craft some of the mod's most advanced components.
